_comment: Tone examples shown to the director's writers, a few at a time. Never used in the game itself. Add freely; keep them deadpan, specific and unexplained.

can whoever keeps logging into wks-0409 stop. that desk was removed in march
badge log says I left at 02:14. I was asleep. my watch agrees I was asleep

ok who moved all the mugs so the handles face the server room
